title: Patch: a dungeon fight left unfinished picks up where it stood, instead of starting over from its first turn
thread:
**Issue #3476 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3476: Patch: a dungeon fight left unfinished picks up where it stood, instead of starting over from its first turn
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Today, when you leave a dungeon run's fight before it ends (the Leave button, a closed tab, a reload), the fight starts over from its first turn next time, with exactly the same deal. A player losing a hard fight can walk away and replay it already knowing every draw, so no fight in a run ever has to be lost. A player whose browser closes by accident loses the turns they played. Once this is built, an unfinished fight comes back exactly where it was left (board, hands, turn), as a free practice game already does after a reload, and leaving no longer resets it.

## Why

- R2706000: a run fight 'is never saved (R668) ... so a fight left unfinished is dealt again from its seed'. `spec/15-dungeon-run.md:167` repeats it.
- The client tells the player so: `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/ConfirmLeaveFight.tsx:27`, 'It ends here and the fight starts over from its first turn.' The game seed is the run's seed, row and column (§15.6), so the redeal is identical: the same draws, the same opening hands, the AI on the same stream.
- Losing is a run's one real stake (abandoning ends it lost, §15.8, R2972000). The daily run (`run_daily_seed`, §15.2) and the leaderboards (§15.10: deepest row, top score, fastest win) all read fights that can be retried for free.
- The machinery exists. R668 keeps a free practice game in the worker's own storage (IndexedDB) after every answer: its config, its action log, the AI stream's cursor and the state's hash. It replays the game to that hash on resume and never sends the log to the page (CLAUDE.md rule 7). `apps/web/src/practice/controller.ts:220` and `:306` skip exactly this for a run fight.
- Hearthstone semantics: a Dungeon Run match in progress is resumed when the player comes back; leaving does not deal it again.

## Proposal

- Keep a run fight in progress the way R668 keeps a free game, in a slot of its own keyed by the run's seed and the fight's row and column, so it never touches the free game's save (which R2706000 protects).
- When the run, still on that fight, starts it again, the worker resumes the kept fight: replayed to its saved hash, with the AI picking up its stream at the saved cursor. A save from another fight or another catalog version, or one that folds differently, is dropped and the fight is dealt fresh, as R668 already does.
- A finished fight, an abandoned run and a new run clear the slot.
- The leave dialog says the fight will wait for you, or the leave guard is dropped for fights. The stopped screen's Try again (R2972000) stays as it is.
- Write a new ruling amending R2706000 and R2972000, edit §15.6's sentence, and put the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/practice/`: `practice.worker.ts`, `resume.ts` and the save store, `controller.ts`, `driver.ts`; and `crates/shared/src/host/practice/` if the save lives in the host.
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/ConfirmLeaveFight.tsx`, `FightScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts`.
- SPEC §15.6 (`spec/15-dungeon-run.md`), `spec/rulings/R2706000.md`, `spec/rulings/R2972000.md`, a new ruling note.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A run fight played for three turns, left and started again resumes on the same turn with the same board, hands and log (a vitest test named after the new ruling, in `driver-run.test.ts` or `controller.test.ts`).
- [ ] The resumed fight reaches the hash it was left at, and the AI's next action equals the one an unbroken game would take from the same point.
- [ ] A run fight's save leaves the free practice game's save untouched, and the reverse holds too.
- [ ] A finished fight, an abandoned run and a new run's first fight find no kept fight.
- [ ] The page never holds the fight's log (R668's assertion extended to run fights).
- [ ] The leave dialog's words match the new behaviour (`FightScreen.test.tsx`).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` and the touched web tests pass.

## Size and risks

Medium to hard, about 10 to 15 files, web and spec only (no engine rule changes). It reverses a sentence of R2706000 on purpose, so the owner should agree to that. Without IndexedDB it must fall back to today's redeal, not fail the fight. No saved fight exists before the change, so nothing needs migrating.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Update the stale header comment ("never saved", "dealt again from its seed") and the guard comments to cite `R3476000`; the guard itself is unchanged. No-IDB browsers fall back for free: the memory store is fresh per mount, resume is refused, start deals fresh.
10. **Web, dialog + store + i18n.** `ConfirmLeaveFight.tsx`: description becomes a new `t()` sentence meaning the fight waits and picks up where left (e.g. "It waits here and picks up where you left it."), header comment updated. `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: add the matching translation (keep the old key; practice uses other strings). `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts`: fire-and-forget `clearStoredRunFight()` in `abandonRun()` next to `removeStored(DUNGEON_RUN_KEY)` and in `startRun()` when a new run commits. `protocol.ts`: update the `run` field and `resume` request comments.
11. **Tests, shared** (`crates/shared/tests/practice.rs`, real catalog, `Session` helper): add `r3476000_a_run_fight_is_saved_and_resumes_to_the_same_state_and_ai_stream` (start `run_config`, answer mulligans, play ~24 mixed actions like the `r668` fold test, take `save`, `PracticeHost::resume`, assert equal hash/snapshot, then play 6 mirrored actions on both and assert equal logs); add `r3476000_resume_refuses_across_free_and_run_and_another_fight` (free save asked as run and run save asked as free both fail; another fight seed fails). Update the run half of `r668_a_lesson_is_never_saved_a_finished_game_clears_the_save_and_a_run_leaves_it_alone`: a run in progress now yields `Some` save, a conceded one `None`, with an `R3476000` comment.
12. **Tests, web driver** (`driver-run.test.ts`): add `it("R3476000 a run fight played three turns resumes on its turn with its board, hands and log", { timeout: 120_000 })`: start `FIGHT` on a `memorySaveStore` that already holds a free save; drive three turns (answer mulligans, loop `aiStep`/legal human `endTurn` like `driver.test.ts`'s `step` helper with `AI_GATE_BUDGET`, `now: () => 0`); assert the free slot still equals its save, the run slot is `Some`, turn ≥ 3; on a fresh driver over the same store send `resume` with the fight config and assert `started`, identical snapshot and hash, `expectRule7`-style secrecy (import it or assert no `nonce` in the JSON and run `runReport` containing no `nonce` after conceding); then take one AI step on both cores and assert equal snapshots (AI stream picked up). Concede and assert the run slot clears.
13. **Tests, web page** (`controller.test.ts`): add `it("R3476000 a run fight's missed resume and start leave practice's memory alone")`: with a stored free resume and last board, `resume(FIGHT)` answered `failed` leaves both stored values untouched and a following `start(FIGHT)` sends `{ type: "start", config: FIGHT }`. (`FightScreen.test.tsx`): update the `R2972000` dialog-text assertion to the new sentence; add `it("R3476000 a kept fight is picked up, else dealt fresh")` with a scripted host that answers `started` to `resume` (assert no `start` sent) and one that answers `failed` to `resume` then `started` to `start`; add `it("R2972000 Try again deals the fight fresh")` (failed start → click retry → second `start`, no `resume`). (`saveStore.test.ts`): `it("R3476000 the run fight's slot is its own")` — free and run saves coexist, each clear leaves the other, and `clearStoredRunFight()` (with `vi.stubGlobal("indexedDB", fake)`) deletes only the run key. (`store.test.ts`): `it("R3476000 abandoning and starting a run drop the kept fight")` via a `vi.mock` spy on `clearStoredRunFight`.
14. **Checks.** Run `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --test practice r3476000`, the `r668`/run-fight tests in the same file, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` for each touched test file, and `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] A 3-turn run fight resumes on its turn with identical board/hands/log, hash, and next AI action.
- [ ] Free and run saves never overwrite each other in either direction.
- [ ] Finished fight, abandoned run, and new run's first fight find no kept fight.
- [ ] No response to the page carries the fight's log (extended rule-7 assertion).
- [ ] Leave dialog shows the new words (`FightScreen.test.tsx` green, incl. `zh-CN`).
- [ ] Try again still deals fresh from the seed.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check`, touched crate/web tests, `fmt`, and `clippy` all pass.

## Risks

- **Determinism:** resume reuses `R668`'s nonce/hash/cursor fold unchanged; the mirrored-play assertions in both shared and web tests catch drift.
- **Hidden information:** the save never crosses to the page (same `Save` output, new slot); `clearStoredRunFight` deletes without reading; `expectRule7`-style and `nonce` assertions guard it.
- **Stale same-seed saves:** a daily run abandoned and restarted the same day shares fight seeds, so abandon/start clear explicitly rather than relying on mismatch-drop.
- **Cross-tab:** a free game in another tab writes the free slot only; slots never collide.
- **No IndexedDB:** resume is refused and the fight deals fresh, same as today; no new failure mode.
- **Flash of the stopped screen** between a refused resume and the fallback start is possible but transient; the effect issues both before paint in the common case.

## Open questions

- The reversal of `R2706000`'s "never saved" sentence needs the owner's agreement; if declined, this plan does not work.
- The exact leave-dialog wording is a proposal; rewording is safe (keep it inside `t()` with a `zh-CN` entry, and keep the test's assertion verbatim-equal).
```
